description: This file defines a report parser class for an analytic account check report in Odoo, including methods to compute and summarize account and analytic line data within date ranges.

classes.name: account_analytic_analytic_check
classes.description: A report parser class for generating analytic account check reports, providing methods to gather and process account data.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up context variables and counters.

methods.name: _lines_p
methods.description: Retrieves and computes account and analytic line balances within a date range for each account.

methods.name: _delta_deb
methods.description: Calculates the difference between general and analytic debits.

methods.name: _delta_cred
methods.description: Calculates the difference between general and analytic credits.
